newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Strike disrupts interbank trading in Bangladesh.
newsitem.headline: Strike disrupts interbank trading in Bangladesh.

text.p: An opposition-led general strike totally disrupted interbank trading on Sunday, dealers said.
"Trading will be highly unlikley as most banks have suspended transaction till the strike ends at 2 p.m.," said one dealer.
Banks in Bangladesh close transactions by 3 p.m. (0900 GMT).
The Bangladesh taka closed at 43.2850/2950 to the dollar in interbank trading on Saturday.
The interbank call money rates closed at 7.0 to 7.5 percent.
